title: Devices
subtitle: The device code prefixes invoice numbers issued offline

registerDialog.title: Register a device
registerDialog.description: A device registers on the POS or kitchen screen itself, so that it receives its own key.
registerDialog.step1: Open the POS app on the new device and choose "Register device".
registerDialog.step2: A manager signs in with username and PIN and picks the branch.
registerDialog.step3: Name the device, pick its kind (POS, handheld, kitchen screen) and register.
registerDialog.step4: It receives a code (for example Q1-P02) and appears in this list.

emptyAction: Register the first POS on that device.

revokeDialog.title: Revoke {{name}}?
revokeDialog.description: The device is signed out now and can no longer be used; the code {{code}} is never reissued. Orders not yet synced on it can no longer be sent.
